expectedBehavior: The current output percentage remains legible at ordinary Watch sizes without crowding the decrement and increment controls, and secondary status is concise and truthful.
notes: Corrected after user review: the control now retains the centered percentage and uses icon-only minus and plus buttons. EV-0018 records the successful Watch build; physical layout verification remains with the user.
observedBehavior: The Output 25% label is oversized on the Watch display, leaving only about two characters visible between the minus and plus controls. The lower Sine · 25% · Watch speaker line also duplicates crowded state information.
reproductionSteps: Install the latest Xcode Watch build and view the output control at its default 25% level on the Watch display.
